about:
Golsh Plastics Inc. is a family-owned and operated distributor based in Worcester, Massachusetts. Founded in 2004, the company began as a local supplier of packaging products for food service and retail businesses in the greater Worcester area.

The company stocks and distributes a range of disposable packaging items including deli containers, foam trays, catering platters, paper bags, food service wipes, guest checks, and product dispensers. It operates a warehouse and counter at 89 Temple Street where customers can walk in during weekday business hours. Golsh Plastics also offers custom printing on packaging materials.

Its customer base spans restaurants, nutrition clubs, grocery stores, liquor stores, convenience stores, bakeries, meat markets, and industrial markets. The company emphasizes timely, friendly service and aims to keep clients' operations running smoothly with products that meet their specific needs.

Golsh Plastics positions itself on quality and service as its specialty, backing that claim with a guarantee of quality products at great prices. The business was started to provide reliable, local access to packaging supplies for the Worcester community.
